presets.label: Edit Copy in a Design
deliverables: revised requested text within the design
presets.guidance: Preserve content not requested for change; check visible wording in returned output when possible.

presets.label: Change Color Palette
presets.guidance: Retain the product, message and identity as requested.

presets.label: Reference-guided Redesign
deliverables: original adapted design informed by a reference
presets.guidance: Transfer direction and composition without promising an exact duplicate. Preserve authorized user assets.

presets.label: Multi-size Adaptation
presets.guidance: Reflow the layout for each size while preserving the key message and product; do not merely stretch the source or regenerate unrelated content.
